Given Gp = 1.8 e^(-2.5s)/(12s+1), with time in min.
(a) Phase = -arctan(12w) - 2.5w rad. Set phase = -pi:
arctan(12w) + 2.5w = 3.1416. Trial gives w = 0.6773, since arctan(8.1275) = 1.4483 and 2.5w = 1.6933, sum = 3.1416.
(b) |Gp| at w_u = 1.8/sqrt(1+8.1275^2) = 1.8/8.1888 = 0.2198. Ku = 1/0.2198 = 4.55.
(c) Pu = 2pi/w_u = 6.2832/0.6773 = 9.28 min.
(d) Kc = Ku/2.2 = 4.55/2.2 = 2.07. tau_I = Pu/1.2 = 9.28/1.2 = 7.73 min.
(e) PI phase adds -arctan(1/(tau_I w)). Total phase = -pi at w = 0.5985 rad/min:
At w=0.5985, |L| = 2.068 x sqrt(1+0.2161^2) x 1.8/sqrt(1+7.182^2) = 0.525. GM = 1/0.525 = 1.90.
(f) Gain crossover: |L| = 1 at w = 0.3235 rad/min (check: 3.722 x 1.0770/4.0087 = 1.000).
Phase there = -(75.56 + 46.34 + 21.80) = -143.70 deg, so PM = 180 - 143.70 = 36.30 deg.
